easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2 if Pious Evangel is on the battlefield.
description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Mortuary and Wayward Disciple triggers if it's on the battlefield
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Wayward Disciple trigger, if applicable, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Viscera Seer enters, Pious Evangel triggers if it's on the battlefield, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.
